list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT asset FROM engine.ema ORDER BY asset

panels.title: Aggregated mid and its EMAs: ${asset} in ${engine}

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, mid, ema5m, ema30m, ema1h, ema4h, ema12h, ema1d FROM engine.ema WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND app = '${engine}' AND asset = '${asset}' ORDER BY time

panels.description: Time-decayed EMAs of the mid of the region's aggregated book, published once a second. The strategy trades the mid crossing its 5m EMA, with the 5m against the 30m as the trend.

panels.title: Orders and fills / min

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, n FROM (SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS time, concat('order ', side) AS series, count() AS n FROM orders.new_order WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND app = '${engine}' GROUP BY time, series UNION ALL SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS time, concat('fill ', side) AS series, count() AS n FROM orders.execution_report WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND status = 'Filled' AND app = replace('${engine}', 'engine-', 'exch-sim-') GROUP BY time, series) ORDER BY time

panels.description: new_order from the engine, execution_report (Filled) from its region's dummy exchange.

panels.title: Position (base) and PnL (quote): ${asset}

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, name, avg(value) AS v FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND app = '${engine}' AND name IN ('position', 'pnl') AND labels['asset'] = '${asset}' GROUP BY time, name ORDER BY time

panels.description: Filled position, and cash plus position at the aggregated mid.

panels.title: Aggregated depth by venue, top 10 a side (base quantity; asks negative)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, v AS venue, avg(depth) AS depth FROM (SELECT ts, v, arraySum(arrayFilter((s, x) -> x = v, bids.size, bids.venue)) - arraySum(arrayFilter((s, x) -> x = v, asks.size, asks.venue)) AS depth FROM engine.agg_book ARRAY JOIN arrayDistinct(arrayConcat(bids.venue, asks.venue)) AS v WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND app = '${engine}' AND asset = '${asset}') GROUP BY time, venue ORDER BY time

panels.description: Which venues make the region's best ten levels, and with how much size, normalised to base quantity from each instrument's spec (OKX contracts x contract value, Deribit USD / price).

panels.title: Aggregated book now: ${asset}

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT argMax(tuple(bids.price, bids.size, bids.venue, asks.price, asks.size, asks.venue), ts) FROM engine.agg_book WHERE app = '${engine}' AND asset = '${asset}' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS b SELECT n AS level, b.3[n] AS bid_venue, b.2[n] AS bid_size, b.1[n] AS bid, b.4[n] AS ask, b.5[n] AS ask_size, b.6[n] AS ask_venue FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(range(1, greatest(length(b.1), length(b.4)) + 1)) AS n)

panels.description: Venues' perpetuals trade at a basis to each other and to spot, so the aggregate is often crossed by a basis point or two: that is the market, not a stale book.

panels.title: Tick to trade, per stage: min, p50, p99, p99.99, max (µs), every tick (weighted window estimates)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, labels['stage'] AS stage, min(min) / 1e3 AS min, sum(p50 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3 AS avg_window_p50, sum(p99 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3 AS avg_window_p99, sum(p9999 * count) / sum(count) / 1e3 AS avg_window_p99_99, max(max) / 1e3 AS max FROM metrics.metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'trace_ns' AND labels['trace'] = 'tick_to_trade' AND app = '${engine}' GROUP BY time, stage ORDER BY time

panels.description: Count-weighted averages of estimated percentiles from individual 5 s windows. These are not combined percentiles of all samples. From the feed handler's receive time: feed (to the engine), decode, book, signal (EMAs), decide, send (the order published). The lab's loops sleep when idle, so feed includes up to 1 ms of that; spin for real numbers.

panels.title: Orders with their tick-to-trade trace (click one)

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp, TraceId, ServiceName, round(Duration / 1e3) AS us FROM tracing.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ParentSpanId = '' AND SpanName = 'tick_to_trade' AND SpanAttributes['why'] = 'kept' AND ServiceName = '${engine}' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: Every tick that led to an order is kept, under the order's id; the dummy exchange's order_ack trace shares it, so the trace view shows both.

panels.title: Feed health: book age by venue (ms)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, labels['venue'] AS venue, max(value) / 1e6 AS age_ms FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND app = '${engine}' AND name = 'book_age_ns' GROUP BY time, venue ORDER BY time

panels.description: Since the venue's feed last delivered a message. A feed handler that moves nodes shows here as a gap of a few seconds.

panels.title: Feed resyncs and top-of-book quotes / s

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(name, ' ', labels['venue']) AS series, sum(delta) / $__interval_s AS rate FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND app = '${engine}' AND name IN ('feed_resyncs', 'tob_quotes') GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.description: A resync is a new publisher session (a restart or a move): that venue's books are dropped and rebuilt from its next snapshot.
